summary: Commercial Vehicle Group, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a Capital on Demand Sales Agreement with JonesTrading Institutional Services LLC. The registrant may, at its discretion, offer and sell up to $25 million of its common stock at-the-market under Rule 415. The Sales Agent receives a 3% commission on gross sales price. No shares are obligated to be sold; the company may suspend at any time. This is an ordinary equity shelf takedown arrangement, not a special-situation event.
